settings.settings_source: item: the E62 copy item whose D and read position (E62's generator at half 7, 8-token windows 'A B .. A M', 512 windows, the last position = the marker) E257's World builds and E275 read; only its D and read position are used, F is each built edit of M. layer, head: E62's copy head (2, 4) (TRIED.md E62: H = (2,4)); the 67M's head h is q/k/v rows and o input columns h*128:(h+1)*128 (rule_retention N_HEAD 6, D_HEAD 128; rho.Layer.z views q/k/v as (n_head, 128), attn_out views o_proj as (d, n_head, 128)), so head 4 is 512:640. factor: the card's x2. too_small: the card's floor (whip-lead, 2026-11-23). The K scan's settings are E268's filed ones (experiments/kstar_needed/run.py load_config: derangements 4, examples 64, seed 268, rows 1024, logit_rows 8192, cache_batch 32, ident_vars 3) at both featurizations; the neuron/head featurization's band is E277's (experiments/needed_neurons/results/predictions.json settings band p97, E229's bounds). q_band: the card's filed band for Q x2 against V x2 at VPD (redteam-lead pre-run note 2026-11-23, note-2026-11-23-redteam-e280-prerun.md: the V x2 algebra on the q matrix)

edits.v2: h.2.attn.v_proj.weight rows 512:640 times factor: head 4's value, so its z and its write, exactly doubled
edits.o2: h.2.attn.o_proj.weight columns 512:640 times factor: the same function as v2 (z enters o_proj linearly)
edits.q2: h.2.attn.q_proj.weight rows 512:640 times factor (only q: head 4's attention logits doubled; k_proj unchanged)

readings.E_b_K: commute.stand_in.explained_share(num, den, dd, K and changed), K by single-variable interchange on D at the marker with E268's scan settings: at VPD commute.needed.needed_set on kstar_vpd.featurize(M, F, ...); at neurons/heads E277's commute.needed_neurons cache and scan on E229's p97 bounds; 1 when K has no changed member (flagged empty_K)
readings.E_b_changed: the same over every changed variable
readings.L2_attn: VPD only, descriptive: per layer-2 attention matrix (q, k, v, o), its subcomponents' and remainder's share of dd over K and changed and their pooled kept share (explained / dd), and for q/k/v redteam-lead's derived kept share sum s_i dd_i / sum dd_i (s_i: subcomponent i's share of |u_i v_i^T|^2 in head 4's rows; e62_diag/diag.py head4_share), over K and changed
readings.sanity: per edit, the copy task's loss at the marker (cross-entropy of the window's B, the token after the first A) minus M's, and the largest |logit| difference between v2 and o2 at the marker; descriptive

rules.R0a: Stage 0 stops the job on any argmax change under the identity interchange (x' = x) on v2's D at each featurization read (VPD: the first 64 windows, three subcomponents and the remainder of every matrix; neurons/heads: the first 64 windows, every variable). The largest logit deviation is the floor, recorded, not barred
rules.R0b: Stage 0 stops the job unless the do-nothing (F a copy of M) at each featurization read has no changed variable, dd max exactly 0.0 and E_b over K exactly 1.0

expected.stage0: identity: 0 argmax changes at both, floor about 1e-4 or below (E268 5.1e-5 at VPD, E277 8.2e-5 at neurons); do-nothing: 0 changed, dd max 0.0, E_b over K 1.0 at both
expected.v2: neurons/heads: E_b over K at least 0.9 (exact by construction, the positive control). VPD: rival A at least 0.5, rival B under 0.3 (0.3 to 0.5 is neither)
expected.o2: neurons/heads: E_b over K at least 0.9 (exact by construction, the positive control). VPD: reported, no expected value
expected.q2: VPD: within q_band (absolute) of v2 at VPD (a check of the derivation: each q subcomponent keeps s_i as each v subcomponent does). Neurons/heads: reported, no band
expected.sanity: v2 and o2 the same function: their logits agree to fp32 rounding (largest difference about 1e-5 of the logit scale or less) and their loss changes agree
